main_text.p: rum, & terram defertam in exitus aquarum : Psalmo 107.35.

head.i: Quid hoc loco piæ menti obseruan-dum censes?

main_text.p: 1. Deum alias improbis submotis è medio, substituere pios. Habet enim pietas promissiones etiam huius uitæ. 1.Tim.4.
8.[?] Vt improbo Sobnæ Eliacim pius succesit.
2. Eundem sæpe submotis pijs è statione locoq;[?], substituere improbos. Olim tempore Achab, partim occisis, partim pulsis ueris Prophetis, Baalitæ successerunt in publico docendi munere.

3. Interdum fit, ut mercenarij aut hostes fidei regnent, submotis pijs tum doctoribus, tum discipulis. Vt tempore Christi & Apostolorum, ordinarium ministerium sibi sumebant Pontifices, Pharisæi, Saducæi, Scribæ, & alij ἑτεροδιδάσκαλοι : & à docendi munere submouebant Apostolos.

4. Quomodocunque autem Deus seu pios, seu impios tractet, nunquam non lucent Dei iusticia & bonitas, piorum feli-citas, & impiorum infelicitas. Etenim, cum malos male tractat Deus, seipsum iustū esse:

page.notes: Page number read as 313; the last digit is slightly faint. The "8." opening the second item is doubtful and probably "2."; marked [?] as printed. "locoq;" has a doubtful abbreviation after "loco", marked [?]. Greek word ἑτεροδιδάσκαλοι copied from the scan; accents are approximate. Dark show-through along the right edge and faint stains are not transcribed.
